Sanjana Mehta
Digital Marketing Manager | Pimpri-Chinchwad
sanjana.mehta369@example.com | +91 9843529537

Results-oriented digital marketing manager with a track record of driving measurable growth in lead generation, engagement, and ROI for B2C and B2B campaigns. Skilled at combining data-driven optimizations with creative content strategies to scale acquisition channels. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 30 days.

Experience

GreenGrid — Nov 2024 - Aug 2026
Digital Marketing Manager, Remote
- Launched and optimized Google Ads search and display campaigns that reduced cost-per-lead by 32% and increased monthly qualified leads from 210 to 440 within six months using continuous bid adjustments and A/B testing.
- Scaled Social Media Marketing across LinkedIn and Instagram, increasing organic engagement rate from 1.1% to 3.8% and growing followers by 85% in nine months through targeted content calendars and paid amplification.
- Implemented landing page experiments and CRO tied to Google Ads, lifting conversion rate from 2.4% to 4.7% and improving campaign ROI by 2.3x.
- Trained a two-person marketing team on campaign setup and reporting, instituting weekly dashboards to track spend, CPA, and channel performance.

CartNest — Feb 2021 - Oct 2024
Digital Marketing Manager, Hybrid
- Owned end-to-end paid acquisition with Google Ads, cutting CAC by 28% year-over-year while scaling monthly revenue from paid channels by 95% through keyword expansion, negative keyword pruning, and smart bidding strategies.
- Used Google Analytics to build a cross-channel attribution model and identify high-intent user segments, which informed Social Media Marketing and Content Writing plans that increased organic sessions by 60% in twelve months.
- Led Content Writing initiatives producing landing pages, blogs, and email sequences that contributed to a 40% uplift in organic conversions and improved time-on-page by 55%.
- Coordinated with product and engineering to deploy tracking and event instrumentation on Linux-based staging environments to validate funnel changes and reduce data discrepancies by 70%.

Projects
- Local SEO Booster: Designed and executed an SEO-focused local listings project for a regional client that improved local pack visibility and increased footfall referrals by 48% in three months.
- Social Content Playbook: Developed a repeatable Social Media Marketing content playbook and calendar templates that reduced campaign prep time by 50% and improved post consistency across channels.

Skills
SEO | Google Ads | Google Analytics
Social Media Marketing | Content Writing
Linux

Education
